newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding up to 60,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding up to 60,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award up to 60,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender later on Wednesday, traders said.
One trader estimated this week's award at between 30,000 and 35,000 tonnes, although another gave a wider range of between 30,000 and 60,000.
The EU awarded 87,750 tonnes last week.
The maximum restitution level was forecast at 42.295 Ecus (European currency units) per 100 kilos of sugar based on the spot August Matif contract. Last week's restitution was 41.653 Ecus.
Licences are currently valid until the end of September as the EU does not normally permit validity to extend into the new campaign.
